answer_gains.text: Choose a local-first system when private drafts, predictable latency, and offline continuity matter more than access to the largest hosted models.
A local workstation complements cloud tools; it does not replace hosted research, frontier reasoning, or collaboration services.
The useful comparison is workflow fit per task, not a single synthetic speed score across unrelated model sizes.

claims.text: Local execution can keep selected working documents on the user's own system when the configured application makes no external request.
Interactive latency depends on model size, quantization, memory bandwidth, context length, and software configuration.
Previously downloaded local models can remain usable during a network outage when their runtime has no online dependency.

contradictions.explanation: Vendor throughput figures are not directly comparable when model, quantization, context, prompt length, and sampling settings differ.
Runtime and model updates can materially change the same hardware's observed performance after publication.
